# ColumnFilter

```csharp
public sealed class ColumnFilter
```

Namespace `SharpCell` · package `SharpCell`

What a column of an [AutoFilter](SharpCell.AutoFilter.md) shows. Make one with a factory such as [ColumnFilter.OneOf](SharpCell.ColumnFilter.md#oneof-string), [ColumnFilter.Custom](SharpCell.ColumnFilter.md#custom-filteroperator-string) or [ColumnFilter.Top](SharpCell.ColumnFilter.md#top-double-bool), and give it to [AutoFilter.Filter](SharpCell.AutoFilter.md#filter-int-columnfilter).
